content: freedesktop Secret Service API (spec 0.2/latest): secrets live as items inside collections, addressed by lookup attributes and a label; collections can be locked and require an unlock (which may prompt the user) before retrieval; a session is established for transport encryption. Implemented by gnome-keyring-daemon and KWallet over D-Bus at org.freedesktop.secrets. Not universally present, so a client must treat absence of the service and a locked collection as ordinary runtime outcomes rather than startup preconditions.
